'''Fuji Sengen Shrine''' or '''Fuji Asama Shrine''' (富士浅間神社, 冨士浅間神社, 富士淺間神社) is one of the {{ill|Sengen shrine|en|Sengen shrine|qid=Q3471785|lt=Sengen Shrines}}.

* {{ill|Fuji Sengen Shrine|ja|富士浅間神社 (飯能市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuji Sengen Shrine (Hanno)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11456097}} - {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}}, {{ill|Hannō|en|Hannō|qid=Q850472|lt=Hanno}}, Kaminaotake Shitabun
* {{ill|Asakusa Fuji Sengen Shrine|ja|浅草富士浅間神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Asakusa Fuji Sengen Shrine|qq=}} - {{ill|Tokyo|en|Tokyo|qid=Q1490|lt=Tokyo}}, {{ill|Taitō|en|Taitō|qid=Q232641|lt=Taito City}}
* {{ill|Fuji Sengen Shrine (Toshima)|ja|富士浅間神社 (豊島区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuji Sengen Shrine (Toshima)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Tokyo, {{ill|Toshima|en|Toshima|qid=Q236680|lt=Toshima}}, Takamatsu.
